metadata.clan_summary:
[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-oe[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Ctrl+J jump pin on the successor card[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]On the successor card in Obsidian and in Mac Capture, Ctrl+J pins [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]one offer as the jump successor. The pinned offer can still be left[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]open, pulled in, marked Done, or canceled. Once every write of the [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]triggering close or capture has landed, Obsidian opens that task's [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]note and focuses its line. The pin never writes to the vault, wins [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]over the Cmd+Return open-notes landing, parks a ]s walk instead of [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]advancing it, and never fails the close if the target can't be [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]found.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]7[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]5[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plan:202611/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]successor_jump_pin.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202611/successor_jump_pin.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]bob-cli-oe[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-cli--beads/blob/main/pages/bob-cli-oe/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]bob capture --jump-offer and the jump JSON contract[/bold #D7AFFF]           [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]cli-jump-offer[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]cli-jump-offer: add `-j, --jump-offer <N|KEY>` to `bob capture`, the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`pull_in.jump.supported` capability, the write-free `offer_jump_stale` [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]refusal, and a top-level `jump` object resolved from final staged text [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF](routed moves, block IDs, cleaned description), with dry-run parity, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]contract vectors, and docs §12.24 plus the picker v5 rows.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Obsidian successor card pin (picker API v5)[/bold #D7AFFF]                   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]nav-pin-card[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]nav-pin-card: in bob-navigation-hotkeys, extract code from fragment 206 [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]to make room, then add the Ctrl+J pin: radio toggle by key, a solid [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]accent `↗ Jump` capsule, hover button, footer chip, summary, and status [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]copy. Enter's highlight fallback is suppressed while a pin is staged, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and a jump-only commit returns `{picks, closes, jump}`. Picker API goes [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]to v5.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Obsidian landing API, walk follow, and receipt line[/bold #D7AFFF]           [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]nav-jump-landing[dim] · [dim][/dim]after nav-pin-card[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]nav-jump-landing: add nav `api.landOnTask(target)`, which re-finds the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]task by identity (never by a clamped line), focuses it, records a Vim [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]jump, and flashes the line. Add reviewWalk v2 `continue(origin, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]{follow})`, which parks the walk before landing, and a notice v5 `↗ “S”`[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]receipt line.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]task-status-cycler honors the pin after every managed Done[/bold #D7AFFF]    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]cycler-jump-close[dim] · [dim][/dim]after nav-jump-landing[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]cycler-jump-close: offer the pin only when the caller can honor it; keep[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`jump` through normalization; resolve the target's post-write identity [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]from picks, closes, or recovery edits; land after retirement and the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]notice, or return it to walk-owned callers. Covers the Vim Ctrl+Enter [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]walk path, parked successors, and cycler API v6.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Wire the remaining Obsidian picker callers[/bold #D7AFFF]                    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]nav-jump-callers[dim] · [dim][/dim]after cycler-jump-close[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]nav-jump-callers: opt the PRE/POST checklist claim and the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]relation-complete compose path into the jump; on project promotion, land[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]on the pin instead of the new ^prj line; leave the pin withheld on the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]relation-merge card. Tests for each.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Mac Capture Pull-In card pin[/bold #D7AFFF]                                  [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]mac-jump-pin[dim] · [dim][/dim]after cli-jump-offer[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]mac-jump-pin: add `jumpKey` to CapturePullInOutcomes. Ctrl+J is consumed[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]by the card's router. Add the capsule with a glide animation, plus [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]footer, button, context-menu, and VoiceOver copy. Gate `--jump-offer` on[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the capability, reopen after `offer_jump_stale`, and on success open the[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]jump landing as a one-entry `bob-open-notes` URL in place of the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]open-notes intent.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Walk docs, decision record, and glossary[/bold #D7AFFF]                      [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]jump-docs-memory[dim] · [dim][/dim]after nav-jump-callers, mac-jump-pin[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]jump-docs-memory: update bob-cli `docs/freshness.md` §6 for the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]pinned-close park, cross-check every surface's Ctrl+J docs, and (per the[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]memory decisions) write the walk-park decision record, the supersession [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]marks, and the glossary term with `just docs-gen`.[/#D7D7AF]
